questions.question: The Self-Respect movement was started by _______ to fight for the people of backward caste to have self-respect in the society.

Which of the following statement(s) is/are true?i. The cold weather season begins mid-November in northern India and lasts till February.ii. October and November are the coldest months in the northern part of India.iii. During winter, the northeast trade winds prevail over the country.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only i and iii) है।

questions.question: Which of the following positions did India secure in the 2025 Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI)?
Which of the following is the objective of the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya scheme?
options: It aims to target youth in age group of 15-35 years.
It aims to clean the rural areas.
It aims at providing road facility in rural areas.
It aims at providing water supply.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (It aims to target youth in age group of 15-35 years.) है।

questions.question: The biochemist ____________ isolated hereditary material in 1869.
Which of the following was the primary purpose of the 21st Constitution Amendment Act, 1967?
options: To include Dogri in the Eighth Schedule
To include Sindhi in the Eighth Schedule
To include Konkani in the Eighth Schedule
To include Maithili in the Eighth Schedule
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (To include Sindhi in the Eighth Schedule) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (मानसून की वापसी) है।

questions.question: Who is the author of the book 'Guts Amidst Bloodbath: The Aunshuman Gaekwad Narrative', published in 2023?
The day of Holika Dahan coincides with the full moon day during the Hindu month of _____________.
What is the primary purpose of the reserve requirement set by central banks?
options: To reduce the number of loans made by banks
To increase the amount of money in circulation
To provide banks with additional profit
To ensure banks have enough funds to meet customer withdrawals
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (To ensure banks have enough funds to meet customer withdrawals) है।

questions.question: Colloidal theory of protoplasm was proposed by ____________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Fischer and Hardy) है।
